title: THE WOUNDED REPUBLIC
text: Three wars in one lifetime have left the Republic thin as old cloth. Its senators speak of order while its fleets count their losses. Judicial patrols still walk the trade lanes, but many worlds once held by Sith lords wait for someone to remember them. Trust is scarce. Strangers are watched.

title: JUDICIAL FORCES
text: The Republic's law-keepers wear grey plate over duraweave and carry carbines issued by the thousand. Their corvettes patrol the trade lanes, boarding anything that smells of contraband. Ask them about the Sith and they answer with a list of names, and most of the names are already dead.

title: THE LOST ONES
text: When the Order was hunted to ash, its survivors scattered into the outer worlds. They learned to hide their sabers beneath cloaks and their names beneath false ones. A few still gather in secret, teaching the young what the Temple once taught openly.

title: THE JEDI RANKS
text: An Initiate is a child in the Temple's care. A Padawan is chosen by a Knight or Master to be trained. A Knight has passed the trials, may walk alone, and may take an apprentice. A Master has trained a Knight or proven wisdom beyond doubt.

title: BATTLEMASTER
text: The Order's chief lightsaber instructor. Only one holds the title at a time, chosen by the High Council to lead the academy's combat training. It is a teaching post, not a rank, and it carries the weight of every student who fell beneath the teacher's eye.

title: THE SITH REMNANTS
text: The Sith empire broke into warring lords and then into ash. What remains is scattered: a cult in one ruin, a tomb-keeper in another, relic hunters who whisper of a master never found. They share no banner. They share a hunger.

title: THE MASKLESS
text: The Triumvirate's assassins were trained to kill Jedi in their sleep and their sanctuaries. Now masterless, they sell their blades to whoever can pay. Some still wear the cowl. Others burned it and kept only the skill. Ask a cowl's wearer for his master's name, and he will not answer.

title: CZERKA CORPORATION
text: Czerka mines the rock, builds the droids, and sells whatever turns a profit. Its contracts are signed in a dozen tongues and honored only when enforced. Scavengers call its surplus crates a gift. The Corporation calls it liability relief.

title: THE HUTT CLANS
text: On Hutta the clans trade in debts, flesh, and favors. The Cartel binds them loosely, and each clan guards its holdings more fiercely than any treaty. Most who serve them never see daylight. Their pits run beneath the cantinas where the bets are placed.

title: TRANDOSHAN HUNTERS
text: The Trandoshans reckon every life in points, awarded by the Scorekeeper for each kill. They take prisoners alive whenever they can, because a living trophy is worth more than a corpse. Their honor is rigid, and once a word is given it becomes law.

title: CONTRACT HUNTERS
text: No guild holds them to account. A hunter takes a name, a price, and a deadline, then vanishes into the cantinas until the job is done. Many carry old Republic blasters and borrowed armor. The best mark their hulls with a single sigil and never explain it.

title: THE MANDALORIAN REMNANT
text: Before the wars, Dxun was a clan stronghold, its bunkers cut deep into the rock. The clans scattered when their war-leader fell. A few stubborn kin still camp in the ruins, rebuilding their war-ways one salvaged plate at a time.

title: THE MANDALORIAN WARS
text: For three bitter years the clans of Mandalore burned their way through Republic space. Their warriors wore armor that shrugged off blaster fire and fought with a fury the Republic had not seen since the old Sith wars. The war ended in fire above Malachor.

title: MALACHOR V
text: A moon scarred by a weapon too terrible to name. Those who survived its last battle heard something tear through the Force, a silence that did not lift. Malachor is said to hold a wound still. Those who walk its ruins come back changed, or they do not come back.

title: THE JEDI CIVIL WAR
text: Brothers and sisters of the Order turned their sabers on one another. Temples burned, and the Council's trust rotted from within. The war ended in a shattered fleet and a galaxy that no longer believed the Jedi stood above politics.

title: THE PURGE
text: For three years the Sith hunted every Jedi who could be found. Assassins struck in temples and cantinas alike, and whole worlds were drained searching for one hidden student. The survivors learned the value of silence, and they have not forgotten the names of the dead.

title: THE THREE
text: Three Sith ruled from a fortress above Malachor. Their war was waged on the Force itself as much as on the Jedi. Their rivalry proved as deadly as their campaign, and the galaxy learned the cost of their victories in cold graves and empty temples.

title: DXUN, THE DEMON MOON
text: A jungle moon of Onderon, thick with beasts that hunt in packs. Mandalorian armies once dug in here, and their bunkers still breathe damp air. Old dark-side residue clings to the trees. The locals call it the demon moon and never go there after dark.

title: TOMB OF FREEDON NADD
text: A black iron spire on a hilltop, raised after the last of a dead Sith lord's worshippers were put down. No vine has ever touched it. Its locked chambers hold scrolls and parasites that feed on the living. Those who enter seldom leave with their minds intact.

title: RAXUS PRIME
text: A world choked with factories and toxic lakes, so crowded with wreckage that its people call it the galaxy's refuse pit. Old war machines sprout from the sludge like weeds. Deep beneath the wreckage, an older engine hums to itself, waiting for someone clever enough to dig.

title: THE PITS OF HUTTA
text: The Hutt homeworld, where slaves are a crop and the pits are a lottery. The arena behind the cantina pays in bets and blood. Losers are tallied, winners are branded with the count of their victories. The galaxy calls Hutta a backwater. Those born there call it a cage.

title: DARTH
text: The old word means dark lord, and many wore it before any rule governed the wearing. A Sith takes it when power has made the claim true. The galaxy respects a title only after the blood has been spilled to earn it, and then fears it.

title: A WOUND IN THE FORCE
text: Some Jedi say the Force flows through all living things. The Sith in broken temples say it has been wounded, and that the wound spreads like rot. Those who touch it feel a silence that does not end. Ask a survivor of Malachor what she heard, and she will not finish.

title: SEEING THE CRACKS
text: Every ship, mind, and bond has flaws. A trained eye sees the strain in a hull, the fear in a voice, the shame beneath a vow. The Force shows these cracks to the patient. Strike there, and the thing breaks for you.

title: QUIET IN THE FORCE
text: A skilled presence can hide inside the Force. Stillness blends it into the ambient flow, and distraction lures a searching mind away. The best hunters vanish into a crowd, leaving only a faint absence that the sharpest senses might notice.

title: SITH ALCHEMY
text: Dark rituals can harden a blade, bind an enchantment into a robe, or wake a relic's sleeping power. The practice is ugly and imprecise. Each success is paid for in pain, and most failures are found in the wreckage of the alchemist's own workshop.

title: HOLOCRONS
text: Crystal memory-engines that hold the teachings of masters and seal them against the unworthy. A holocron may speak, plead, or lie. Its locks answer to the bearer's intent, and its voice remembers the one who recorded it long after that one is dead.

title: KYBER
text: The crystal at the heart of every lightsaber. Its color answers to the hand that holds it. Pure kyber sings bright for the light, but bends and blackens under dark hands. Those who cut crystals say the stone remembers the first voice that touched it.

title: TAINTED KYBER
text: Crystals grown or corrupted in the dark. Their color is wrong, a red that bleeds at the edges. They answer rage with a surge of power and repay it with corruption that creeps into the bearer's hand. Synthetic crystals copy the look, but not the cost.

title: ASSASSIN DATABANK
text: A Czerka-pattern droid mind built to study enemies. It records every stance, flinch, and hesitation. Its voice is dry and its loyalty conditional. Its advice is always about patterns: Jedi are creatures of ritual, it says, and ritual can be broken.

title: STEALTH COURIER
text: A slender courier hull with a cloak that swallows starlight. Its engines are quiet, its sensors cheap, and its hold smells of burnt coolant. Smugglers prize it because no patrol logs its passage. Its name changes with every owner, and so does its paint.

title: CR90 CORVETTE
text: An old Republic workhorse, its bow scarred by a hundred boarding actions. The Judicial Forces retired it to the scrapyards, and then scavengers bought it cheap. Its turbolasers still fire, though the power couplings grumble. It is slow, ugly, and very hard to kill.

title: REPUBLIC CARBINE
text: A blaster carbine issued by the thousand to Republic infantry. It is heavy, accurate, and easy to strip in the dark. Its power cell fits a dozen civilian blasters. Soldiers say it kicks like a mule and never jams, the only praise a soldier gives a weapon.

title: COMBAT PLATE
text: Layers of composite plate over a flexible weave. It stops a blaster bolt at close range and softens a vibroblade's bite. It is loud when worn, and its seams wear through in one bad season. Mercenaries strip it and sell the plates separately.
